from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Check if we have cached results for the outbound flight (Raleigh to Memphis, May 13-22)
outbound_cache_key = "departure_flights"
outbound_cached = get_results_from_cache(key=outbound_cache_key)

# Check if we have cached results for the return flight (Memphis to Raleigh, May 22)
return_cache_key = "return_flights"
return_cached = get_results_from_cache(key=return_cache_key)

# If outbound flights are not cached or need filtering (afternoon departure), search/filter
if outbound_cached is None:
    # Search for outbound flights: Raleigh to Memphis, departure_date May 13, 2025, afternoon time (12:00-17:00)
    outbound_search = search_flights(
        start_airport_city="Raleigh",
        end_airport_city="Memphis",
        departure_date=["May 13, 2025"],
        departure_time=["12:00:00", "17:00:00"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key=outbound_cache_key, value=outbound_search)
    outbound_cached = outbound_search

# If return flights are not cached or need filtering (afternoon departure), search/filter
if return_cached is None:
    # Search for return flights: Memphis to Raleigh, departure_date May 22, 2025, afternoon time (12:00-17:00)
    return_search = search_flights(
        start_airport_city="Memphis",
        end_airport_city="Raleigh",
        departure_date=["May 22, 2025"],
        departure_time=["12:00:00", "17:00:00"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key=return_cache_key, value=return_search)
    return_cached = return_search

# Since the user is flexible on time but prefers afternoon, we can filter both flights to ensure afternoon departures
# Filter outbound flights for afternoon departure (12:00-17:00)
if outbound_cached.search_results:
    outbound_filtered = filter_flights(
        prior_results=outbound_cached,
        departure_time=["12:00:00", "17:00:00"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights_filtered", value=outbound_filtered)
else:
    outbound_filtered = None

# Filter return flights for afternoon departure (12:00-17:00)
if return_cached.search_results:
    return_filtered = filter_flights(
        prior_results=return_cached,
        departure_time=["12:00:00", "17:00:00"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="return_flights_filtered", value=return_filtered)
else:
    return_filtered = None

# Since the user is traveling solo, no need to adjust for number of people/rooms
